entities.name: Fernão Vaz Dourado
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fernão Vaz Dourado was a Portuguese cartographer. He belonged to the third period of the old Portuguese nautical cartography, which is characterised by the abandonment of Ptolemaic influence in the representation of the Orient and better accuracy in the depiction of lands and continents. Little is known about this historical figure.
